senses.gloss:
यच्छत् यच्छत्, यच्छमान. See under
rt. यम्, p. 809, col. 1.
यच्छत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, restraining, controlling.
यच्छन्दस् यच्-छन्दस्. See under यद्.

यच्छमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. stretching out,
extending; distributing.

याच् याच्, cl. 1. P.A. याचति, -ते, य-
याच, ययाचे, याचिष्यति, -ते, अयाचीत्,
अयाचिष्ट, याचितुम्, to ask, beg, solicit, pray, re-
quest, desire, entreat, require, implore, supplicate,
importune (with double acc., e. g. देवं वरं
याचते, he solicits a boon from the god; also with
abl. and rarely with gen. of person, e. g. अन्नम्
परात् or परस्य याचते he begs food from an-
other; or the thing asked may be compounded with
अर्थे or अर्थम्, e. g. मोक्षार्थम् याचते, he
asks for deliverance; or may be in acc. with
प्रति, e. g. सुतम् प्रति ययाचे, he asked for
a son; or in dat., e. g. तं ययाचे ऽभ्यव-
हाराय, he asked him for food); to offer any-
thing (acc.) to any one (dat.), tender (e. g. याचति
वित्तं गुरवे, he offers property to the Guru); to
promise (?); कन्यां याच्, to be a suitor for a girl,
to ask a girl in marriage from any one (abl. or rarely
[]
acc.): Pass. याच्यते: Caus. याचयति, -यितुम्, Aor.
अययाचत्, to cause to ask, &c.: Desid. यियाचिषति,
-ते, (in Ṛg-veda VIII. 67, 1, याचिषामहे = या-
चामहे): Intens. यायाच्यते, यायाक्ति (1st sing.
यायाच्मि), to ask repeatedly, importune; [cf. Gr.
αἰτέω, which however may be connected with rt.
अर्थ्; cf. also, according to some, ζητέω.].

याचक, अस्, ई, अम्, asking, one who asks or
solicits, a petitioner, asker, beggar; (ई), f. a female
beggar or petitioner.
—याचक-वृत्ति, इस्, f. the
occupation or profession of a beggar.

याचन, अम्, n. the act of asking, begging, re-
questing; asking in marriage, (दुहितृ-याचन, the
being a suitor for a daughter); (आ), f. asking, solicit-
ing, requesting, entreating, petitioning; a request,
petition, entreaty.

याचनक, अस्, m. an asker, petitioner, an impor-
tunate man.

याचनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be asked, to be desired
or requested.

याचमान, अस्, आ, अम्, asking, begging, re-
questing, soliciting.

याचित, अस्, आ, अम्, asked, prayed for, begged,
requested, solicited, entreated, importuned (with acc.,
e. g. दशरथो रामं याचितः, Daśaratha was
asked for Rāma); requisite, necessary.

याचितक, अम्, n. anything borrowed, any article
borrowed for use.
याचितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be asked or solicited.

याचितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who begs or solicits, an
asker, petitioner; a suitor, wooer.
याचित्वा, ind. having asked, having solicited.
याचिन्, ई, इनी, इ, asking, desiring, requesting.

याचिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, disposed to ask, habitually
asking or begging, soliciting favours, importuning,
an importunate person.
—याचिष्णु-ता, f. the habit
of soliciting favours, importunity.

याच्ञा, f. the act of asking, requesting, begging,
solicitation, asking alms, mendicancy, mendicity; a
petition, request, prayer, entreaty; the being a
suitor, making an offer of marriage.
—याच्ञा-जीवन,
अम्, n. subsisting by begging or mendicancy.
—याच्-
ञा-प्राप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, obtained by begging or
asking.
—याच्ञा-भङ्ग, अस्, m. failure of request,
an unsuccessful entreaty, useless request.
—याच्ञा-
वचस्, अस्, n. words used in begging or entreating.
याच्ञ्य, अस्, m. or याच्ञ्या, f., Ved. = याच्ञा above.

याच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be asked or solicited, to be
importuned, to be asked for alms, to be desired or
requested; to be required; (अम्), n. the making a
request.

याच्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being asked or solicited,
being prayed for.
याच्छ्रेष्ठ याच्-छ्रेष्ठ. See under 2. यात्.
